## Workload

Marcus Bell completed 645 reads during the review period, recording 495 hours of work. This represents 1.3 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the recorded hours and the volume of reads completed. The figures provide a clear basis for assessing throughput and support consideration of the grader’s overall performance during the period.

## Quality

A total of 57 reads were checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 73.7 per cent. The result was considered alongside the workload information and the checked sample. Priya Anand completed the review and recorded the findings for consideration. The review supports continuation of the existing approach to the grader’s work. Any future review should consider both workload and agreement to maintain a balanced assessment.
